title: OpenAI’s letter to Governor Abbott on responsible AI infrastructure in Texas
summary_lines: OpenAI sent Governor Greg Abbott a letter outlining its commitment to responsible AI infrastructure in Texas. The letter supports reliable, transparent growth that benefits Texans.
